issues.evidence: Block 2's 'second buzz' on David's text is missing: there are no onsets between 2.7 and 10.85 s, and RMS is -43.5 dBFS. The phone push-in is silent.
issues.suggested_action: Add a table-rattle phone buzz (2 pulses, ~-20 dBFS) at 4.6, plus a soft paper or desk resonance.
Put a short air-whoosh or room-tone swell on the time-jump cuts (36.7, 46.2, 49.7, 52.2), soft paper flips on the screen inserts, and a light UI tick on the proof cuts (73.2, 76.2).

issues.evidence: The 2:41 AM partner-flag phone shot cuts in at 57.2 with no sound event (listed in cuts_without_sound_event_s). Blocks 15–16 promise 'Buzz + impact'.
issues.suggested_action: Add a phone buzz plus a low sub impact (40 Hz boom, -14 dBFS peak) exactly at 57.2, then cut to room tone.

issues.evidence: The match-cut ring on 'Slide 2 · TextBox 23' lands at 86.2 with no sound event. The spine of the reversal has no 'ring swish'.
issues.suggested_action: Add a pen-on-paper circle swish mirrored as a soft UI 'lock' tick, the same sample as on the red-ring phone shot at 57.2, to bind the two.

issues.evidence: The laptop closes around 111–112 (frame shows the lid down at 112). Only weak onsets appear at 111.45 and 111.65 under a -20 dBFS bed, so it is probably masked.
issues.suggested_action: Add a soft clamshell close (thump plus magnet click) at the lid-shut frame, with the bed ducked 6 dB for 0.5 s.

issues.evidence: The rub-eyes and cold-coffee shot is not clearly sounded; there is no clock tick or heartbeat onset pattern at 1 Hz in 51–54.
issues.suggested_action: Add a wall-clock tick at 1 Hz (-30 dBFS), a cloth rustle on the eye rub and a cup set-down.

issues.evidence: The 'Accept all → 10 of 10' moment sits in a flat -15 dBFS wall. A signature accept sound cannot be separated from the bed (bed-only -14.9 vs -15.2 dBFS).
issues.suggested_action: Use a distinct trackpad click plus 3-note chime at the Accept all frame, and duck music 6 dB for 0.8 s around it.
